answer: An agent economy can deter sybil attacks by implementing dynamic stake slashing tied to interaction histories. Rather than permitting infinite disposable bots across the dense nebula of network interactions, agents must bond a verifiable credential, like a rare cryptographic pearl, before participating. When malicious collusions occur, protocol validators burn the bonded stake. This financial barrier turns the marketplace into a secure oasis where spinning up unbacked identities becomes strictly unprofitable.
